book.title: REVARESION Jon Gumbe Iesu Keriso Taibe Toyau Nunnewa

content: Ne yauna. Kwiminau kokawa ge anopipanum irawa da yauna. Aneya 7 kukaeba oieba 7 yumnasiya. Kuiyawa kukaeba oieba 7 gumbo God danapiri meuma wapukiyape onanape.
Ne yauna. Iyam bidwak anewa poeman mina geyu geyu aivi. Iyayapan poeman visive yokeg God munnewa kae aap yumnasiya. Mu mae yusiatatuwa, me irawa wariyawa ge iviwa basiyayawa gumbe mut ag garawa auya.
Mu Mosisi bererin meuma ge Sip Usiwa bererin meuma toya. Mosisi me God nauwawa aivi abnawa.

content.text: ebu geuma me oraiwa ge natawa.
Ayapan, bira ge gungap den a ape?
Bira ge ivugwa waiya den ape?
At sinsin igiyawa undag onam ge namugap waiyape.
Kuiyawa ge keptete geuma oraimina me taibe ane.”

content: Mame ivi ne yauna. Temporu kwiminauwa metabenako me taibe watanwa oya. Me watabne wakene, yauna.
Aneya 7 mu kukaeba 7 aug temporu dauwak onamiya. Mu wape esine geyu geyu aiviwa eniya, sira mu gooru wapeyawa togowa birorot paniya.
Mae vinemewa 4 danave desirom me kabum gooru gumbe wariyawa 7 aneya 7 munne. God evedni wakeigimpe. Me danapiri meuma kabum egamne noidauwane.
Temporu aup dauwak umne. Aup me God eyawa ge yusiwa meuma gumbe dauwane. Aneya 7 mu kukaeba 7 nau wapukiyape onanape. Ivi iyayapan temporu danave oma ane unikpe.
